operator_context: Dave identified the next evolution threshold: TOD must prove material implementation, MIM must suppress internal lifecycle/debug language in operator conversation, and MIM/TOD must distinguish fresh evidence from new wrappers around stale work.

objectives.title: TOD material implementation proof gate
objectives.goal: TOD must reject wrapper-only success and prove real implementation materialized before any implementation objective can be marked complete.
required_actions: Require a real diff for implementation objectives.
Require at least one relevant expected file to be touched or an explicit no-change justification.
Require validation output tied to the changed behavior, not only syntax or wrapper checks.
Require live-path proof when the objective affects UI/API/scheduler/dispatcher/operator-visible behavior.
Attach regression evidence and changed-file summary to completion artifacts.
Auto-reject completion when only status wrappers, summaries, or regenerated metadata changed.
success_criteria: Implementation completion artifacts include material_diff_present=true, relevant_files_touched, validation_changed_or_relevant=true, live_path_changed_or_verified, and regression_evidence.
TOD can distinguish orchestrating Codex from independently materializing a bounded patch.

objectives.title: MIM conversational synthesis enforcement
objectives.goal: MIM must speak to Dave in concise operator-facing language and suppress orchestration/debug/lifecycle leakage unless diagnostics are explicitly requested.
required_actions: Apply response synthesis policy to normal voice and UI replies.
Filter lifecycle fields, request IDs, artifact names, dispatch statuses, and internal task envelopes from normal conversation.
Compress status into: what changed, what is blocked, what matters now, and next action.
Preserve diagnostic detail only behind explicit 'show details', 'debug', or 'artifact' requests.
Create test prompts that currently produce lifecycle leakage and require human-readable replacements.
success_criteria: MIM can summarize active objectives in under five short sentences without lifecycle leakage.
A regression set proves artifact/debug phrasing is suppressed by default.
Voice responses stay concise unless Dave asks for detail.

objectives.title: Freshness provenance and evidence trust ranking
objectives.goal: MIM/TOD must know whether an artifact contains fresh execution evidence or merely re-describes old work.
required_actions: Add freshness provenance fields to objective/status artifacts.
Track source artifact age separately from wrapper artifact age.
Rank evidence by trust: live-path execution, validation output, material diff, direct runtime state, summary wrapper.
Prevent stale source evidence from being promoted by a fresh summary timestamp.
Make hourly reflection report stale-source warnings in operator language.
success_criteria: Fresh wrapper around stale source evidence is flagged as stale_under_fresh_wrapper.
Objective completion requires trusted fresh evidence, not only a new latest file.
Hourly reflection reports source aging and trust rank for key artifacts.

operator_instruction: MIM/TOD should execute these priorities before expanding lower-priority features. These are autonomy foundations: material proof, conversational clarity, and evidence freshness truth.
